youtube_description:
'0% interest' is not 0% cost: processing fees, convenience fees and GST add up. Since 1 Oct 2024, RBI requires banks and NBFCs to give a Key Facts Statement (KFS) for every retail loan, showing the APR (Annual Percentage Rate) = the all-in cost including fees. A fee not in the KFS can't be charged without your explicit consent. Fix: ask for the KFS before signing and compare loans by APR.
Source: RBI circular on Key Facts Statement (15 Apr 2024), effective 1 Oct 2024.
Education only, not financial advice.
